title: RetroArch 1.21.0: official development build
summary: RetroArch published 1.21.0 on May 1, 2025. The release record documents an official development build for the multi-system emulator project.

blocks.text: The RetroArch project published version 1.21.0 on May 1, 2025. GitHub marks this entry as a release; this distinction is preserved here so the build is not mistaken for a different update channel.

The GitHub record does not include an inline changelog, but it identifies version 1.21.0 and publishes these release files: retroarch-sourceonly-1.21.0.tar.xz (12928140 bytes). The version, date, and package record are retained in this article.
